schema.prompt: Which action does the rule book say to take?

options.label: ignore
options.description: No smoke, temperature below 45 °C and humidity above 20%. Nothing is unusual.

options.label: monitor
options.description: No smoke, and only one problem: very hot (45 °C or more) or very dry (20% or less), but not both.

options.label: drone
options.description: No smoke, and both problems at once: very hot (45 °C or more) and very dry (20% or less).

options.label: brigade
options.description: The camera sees smoke, whatever the temperature and the humidity are.
